Теневой режим использует выбранный урове: Shadow mode uses the selected data level and shows scores without changing masking decisions.

S1 видит значение и маскированное окно к: S1 sees the value and a masked context window. Masking also uses the filtered profile of confirmed entities; discovery scores its own examples.
